first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention. I will verify the prior onboarding and signup-simplification records to distinguish where the friction lies. A small guarded test protects downstream qualified revenue and avoids broad promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding for self-serve accounts, with completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue guardrails. The verified onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and retention, directly matching the current declines. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and was not validated beyond SMB, so avoid broadly reducing signup requirements and preserve segment uncertainty.
